comparison.objective: Clean a chip through solvent baths while avoiding a hazardous solvent-wet piranha transfer; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential dipping, timed submersion, and hazard-aware handling versus fine mechanical adjustment, locking, and repeated guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Two-second ordered baths and safe holder placement, with zero for unsafe piranha transfer, versus two safe carriage stops and retention testing.
comparison.reason: Chemical sequence and hazard recognition do not test damper tuning.
